template: Tenant Protection Act just cause eviction requirement (Civil Code 1946.2) applies to this address. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 (as amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203 (AB 1529)); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: The Tenant Protection Act's "just cause" rule (Civil Code 1946.2) applies to this address, so a landlord needs a legally recognized reason to evict a tenant here. Source: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 (as amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203 (AB 1529)); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
